full_prompt_en: A square decorative illustration places a seated woman in profile inside a large circular floral frame. She faces left with dark hair gathered into a low bun and a pale cream dress flowing around her bent knees. A white rabbit sits on the ground before her, looking outward. Pink blossoms and brown leaves arch over and around the pair, while climbing stems and patterned foliage fill the lower corners. The circular opening is warm muted olive, and an outer beige border carries faint repeating floral ornament. Thin precise contours define the woman's face, dress folds, rabbit, and plant stems. Flat areas of cream, taupe, dusty rose, olive, and soft brown alternate with dense small botanical detail. The light is gentle and even, with no realistic cast shadow; separation comes from overlapping shapes and controlled value. The woman and rabbit occupy the quiet lower middle, while the blossom canopy creates a lyrical rhythm above. The composition is strongly balanced by the circle yet softened by irregular plants. Fine paper texture and subdued print color give the image an antique book-plate finish. The whole frame feels contemplative, tender, and ornamental, with the figure and animal integrated into one stylized garden design.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形装饰插画把一位坐姿女子侧面放在巨大的圆形花卉框内。她朝左，深色头发盘成低髻，浅乳白裙摆围着屈起双膝流下。一只白兔坐在她面前地面上，朝外看。粉色花朵与棕叶在两人上方和周围成拱，攀援枝茎与图案化叶丛填满下角。圆形开口是温暖低饱和橄榄色，外围米色边框有淡淡重复花饰。纤细准确的轮廓界定女子面孔、衣褶、兔子与植物茎。乳白、灰褐、灰粉、橄榄与柔棕的平面色区同密集细小植物细节交替。光温和且均匀，没有写实投影；层叠形状与受控明度带来分离。女子与兔子安静地坐在下方中央，花冠在上方形成抒情节奏。构图由圆形强力平衡，又被不规则植物柔化。细纸纹与低调印刷色彩赋予古书画页质感。整体沉思、温柔、装饰性强，人物与动物融入一体化风格花园设计。
style_prompt_en: An Art Nouveau decorative illustration style arranges a quiet focal grouping within a large circular frame and dense botanical ornament. Thin precise contour, flat muted color, and repeated floral motifs carry the design. Cream, taupe, dusty rose, olive, and soft brown remain gently aged rather than vivid. Even light and overlapping shapes provide depth without realistic cast shadows. The frame is balanced but plant stems and leaves bring irregular movement. Fine paper grain and slightly faded printing reinforce an antique book plate. Human or animal figures can be integrated with their surroundings through matching line weight and rhythmic curves. The mood is lyrical, calm, and ornamental.
style_prompt_zh: 新艺术装饰插画风格把安静的焦点组合安置在大圆形框和密集植物纹样中。纤细准确轮廓、平涂低饱和颜色和重复花形承担设计。乳白、灰褐、灰粉、橄榄和柔棕显得温和陈旧，而不鲜艳。均匀光与重叠形状提供纵深，不依赖写实投影。框架平衡，植物茎叶又带来不规则流动。细纸纹与略褪色印刷强化古书画页质感。人物或动物形体可凭匹配的线条轻重与有节奏曲线融入周围。气氛抒情、平静、装饰性强。
theme_en: A seated woman and white rabbit within a circular floral Art Nouveau frame
theme_zh: 一位坐着的女子与白兔处在圆形花卉新艺术边框中
name: Kate Baylay
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
